description: This file defines extension methods for scheduling work items within the Orleans runtime scheduler, specifically for grain contexts. It adds methods to queue tasks and actions, and to run or queue tasks conditionally.

classes.name: SchedulerExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for scheduling tasks and work items within Orleans runtime's scheduler context.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Queues a task represented by a Func<Task> onto the specified WorkItemGroup scheduler, associated with a grain context.

methods.name: QueueAction
methods.description: Queues an action with a specified state onto the target grain context's scheduler, returning a task that completes when the action is executed.

methods.name: RunOrQueueTask
methods.description: Runs the task immediately if the current context matches the target context; otherwise, queues it to be run later.
